uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When at 50% max HP or below, increases critical-hit rate by 10% and auto attack speed by 20% for 5s (30s CD). When hitting an opposing Pokémon with an auto attack or move, places a cinder on the target for 5s; applies 2 cinders with boosted attacks and moves. When placing a 5th cinder on a target, consumes the cinders, dealing additional damage to the target. 0.7% Enemy Max HP x (Level - 1) Against Wild Pokémon: The total damage is capped at 500. When using a move, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. When hitting an enemy with a basic attack or move, a cinder is placed on that enemy. Attacking a cindered enemy a certain number of times will cause the cinder to flare, dealing damage to the enemy. When at half HP or less, critical-hit rate is increased by 10% and basic attack speed is increased by 20% for a short time.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack or after using a move, dealing increased damage. Boosted attacks remain readied until used. Against wild Pokémon: basic attack damage is capped at 1000; boosted attack damage is capped at 1300. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits.

Shoots a small flame at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and burning them for 3s (dealing damage 3 times). The Attack and Sp. Atk of the burned target are decreased by 5% for 2s. Shoot out a small flame, dealing damage to enemies, leaving them burned and decreasing their Attack for a short time.

Kicks up a stone and ignites it, then kicks the ball of flame in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and burning them for 3s (dealing damage 3 times). The Attack and Sp. Atk of burned opposing Pokémon are decreased by 5% for 2s. Kick a ball of flame in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies and leaving them burned for a short time when this move hits.
Reduces the cooldown of Flame Charge or Feint by 4s when this move hits. Reduces the cooldown of Flame Charge or Feint when this move hits.

Becomes unstoppable and performs a fiery flying kick dashing toward the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target with a guaranteed critical hit, shoving them for 0.5s, and burning them for 3s (dealing damage 3 times); then jumps back a set distance from the target or in the direction of movement and becomes vulnerable to hindrances when they land. The Attack and Sp. Atk of the burned target are decreased by 5% for 2s. Perform a fiery flying kick. This move is always a critical hit, and it shoves enemies and leaves them burned for a short time. In addition, become immune to hindrances while using this move.
Increases basic attack speed by 45% for 3s when this move hits. Increases basic attack speed for a short time when this move hits.
Dashes forward with a low sweep, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. Make a swift low sweep in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemy it hits.
Dashes forward cloaked in flame, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. Charge forward cloaked in flame, dealing damage to any enemy hit.

The next boosted attack after this move ends decreases the movement speed of the opposing Pokémon hit by 30% for 2s. The next boosted attack after this move ends also decreases the movement speed of enemies hit for a short time.
Becomes invincible for 0.73s while dodging, cleansing any slows, and increasing movement speed by 40% for 2s. Increases movement speed for a short time and become invincible.

The next 3 auto attacks after dodging restore HP for 30% of damage dealt. These 3 auto attacks cannot critically hit. After this move is used, basic attacks that hit enemies restore HP (up to 3 times).

Becomes unstoppable and kicks up a giant ball of flame, then kicks it toward the location of the designated opposing Pokémon. The ball releases a fierce shock wave upon impact, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit; and increasing movement speed by 10% for 5s when this Unite Move hits. 14% of enemy missing HP. Create a giant ball of flame and kick it toward the designated location. The ball releases a fierce shock wave that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also increases movement speed by 10% (stacks with the Unite Buffs) for 5s when it hits.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
